prompt: Which of the following describes all solutions to $3x - 5 > 10$?
hint: Solve it exactly as you would an equation — you are dividing by a positive number, so the sign will not flip.

hints.text: Solve it exactly as you would an equation — you are dividing by a positive number, so the sign will not flip.

explanation: Divide both sides by $3$. Since $3$ is positive, the direction of the inequality does not change: $x > 5$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Test a value to confirm the direction
steps: If you are unsure whether the answer is $x > 5$ or $x < 5$, test one number from each side.
One test settles the direction, and it takes five seconds.
